listing.name: Halo 2 — Open Halo 2 (andrewnakas)
listing.summary: README describes launch and online room/OpenLive routes; console640x480 and DSP reverb absent. No complete campaign claim. Mac/Linux/browser planned only. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Original retail Xbox disc only; Redump ISO/XISO or extracted default.xbe. Launcher verifies one retail revision; exact accepted fingerprint still needs release manifest read.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Release OpenHalo2.exe imports disc and locally lifts/compiles halo2_recomp.exe. Bundled LLVM/lifter; Microsoft CRT/SDK libraries from existing VS or licensed xwin download. OpenGL3.3.
